EnterpriseRAG Deterministic Remote Work Policy

Employees may work remotely for up to three days per week.
Tuesday and Thursday are designated collaboration days.
An employee may request a fully remote arrangement when the employee lives more than 120 kilometres from the assigned office.
The fully remote arrangement requires approval from the department director and People Operations.
The home-office allowance is GBP 600 and becomes available after 30 days of employment.
The annual learning budget is GBP 1,200.
This policy does not state the CEO's name.
